title: Concept: XML parser with entities enabled (python) — review required
description: In python, XMLParser(resolve_entities=True) switches entity processing on. XXE payloads abuse doctypes to exfiltrate files and scan networks through the parser's authority. The remedy is disabling entities via resolve_entities=False.
applicability: python XML parsing configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: File disclosure and SSRF through malicious XML; HIGH severity.
